title: Ali Ek Zaroori Cheez Bhool Gaya! 🎒 | Ghar Se Nikalne Ki Dua | Islamic Cartoon for Kids
description:
Ali school ke liye bhaag raha tha... aur ek zaroori cheez bhool gaya! 🎒 Ammi ne roka aur Abbu ke saath Ali ne ghar se nikalne ki dua padhi — bachchon ke liye ek pyaari Islamic kahani.

Dua: "Bismillahi, tawakkaltu 'alallah, la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah"
Matlab: Allah ke naam se, maine Allah par bharosa kiya, Allah ke siwa koi taaqat aur quwwat nahi.
English: In the name of Allah, I trust in Allah; there is no power and no strength except with Allah.

📖 Source:
• Ghar se nikalne ki dua — Sunan Abu Dawud 5095, Jami at-Tirmidhi 3426, Anas ibn Malik (RA) (Sahih)

Aapka bachcha school jaate waqt yeh dua padhta hai? Comment mein batayein! 👇
Roz nayi kahani — Hidayah: Ali aur Dadu.
